description: This Java class, InteropResponseData, represents a data transfer object (DTO) used to encapsulate the response details in an interoperability context within the FintecaFineract project. It extends CommandProcessingResult and includes fields for transaction code, action state, expiration, and extensions, along with methods for constructing instances and handling date formatting/parsing.

classes.name: InteropResponseData
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating the response details for interoperability operations, including transaction code, state, expiration, and related extensions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static factory methods for constructing instances of InteropResponseData with various parameter combinations.

methods.name: getTransactionCode
methods.description: Returns the transaction code associated with the interoperability response.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the interoperability action.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Returns the expiration timestamp as a formatted string.

methods.name: getExpirationDate
methods.description: Returns the expiration as a LocalDateTime object by parsing the formatted string.

methods.name: getExtensionList
methods.description: Returns the list of extension data associated with the response.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a LocalDateTime using the class's date formatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a LocalDateTime into a string using the class's date formatter and tenant timezone.
